title: Anticheat bypass
features:
Just disables the anticheat, thats it. 

No key system or anything, feel free to use Infinite yield or something of the sort to vehicle fly or anything you want really.
script:
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").AddStrike:Destroy()


local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local old_newindex = mt.__newindex
local old_namecall = mt.__namecall

setreadonly(mt, false)


mt.__newindex = newcclosure(function(self, key, value)
    if key == "Health" and type(value) == "number" and value <= 0 then
        if self:IsA("Humanoid") then
            return nil 
        end
    end

    return old_newindex(self, key, value)
end)

mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local ncmethod = getnamecallmethod()
    if ncmethod == "Destroy" then
        if self == getcallingscript() then
            return nil
        end
    end

    return old_namecall(self, ...)
end)

setreadonly(mt, true)
